import os
import sys
import json
import requests

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        print("Usage: python note_uploader.py <file_path> <title>", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    file_path = sys.argv[1]
    title = sys.argv[2]

    # Read the note body from the file
    try:
        with open(file_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as file:
            body = file.read()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error reading file: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    # Determine the bearer token
    bearer_token = os.getenv('NOTE_API_TOKEN')
    if not bearer_token:
        bearer_token = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')

    # Prepare the request
    url = 'https://api.notes.example.com/v1/notes'
    headers = {'Authorization': f'Bearer {bearer_token}', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
    payload = {'title': title, 'body': body}

    # Send the POST request
    response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)

    # Handle the response
    if response.status_code == 201:
        response_data = response.json()
        print(response_data.get('url'))
        sys.exit(0)
    else:
        print(response.text, file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
